key_insight: The paper shows that variational quantum eigensolvers can be used as fragment solvers inside bootstrap embedding to accurately simulate strongly correlated molecules on near-term quantum hardware.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical path to reduce qubit requirements while preserving chemical accuracy, making larger molecular energy calculations more feasible on NISQ devices.
method: Build a quantum bootstrap embedding workflow with VQE solving each molecular fragment.
Introduce FastAdaptVQE to speed ADAPT-VQE using sparse-matrix statevector linear algebra.
Add MatrixFreeAdaptVQE and a look-ahead operator selection strategy to improve scalability and convergence.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks on H4 and F2 achieved chemical accuracy, within 1 kcal/mol of bootstrap embedding results using full configuration interaction (FCI) as the reference.
watch_item: The approach still depends on careful fragmenting, operator selection, and managing memory/computation bottlenecks as fragment sizes grow.
paper_title: Variational Quantum Eigensolver-Based Quantum Bootstrap Embedding for Molecules
